seed_scope: paired development seeds; previously observed 001/002 seeds are not untouched confirmation

schedule.anneal: geometric, inclusive endpoints; soft forward until step 2500
schedule.hard: selected-only argmax; selected-value probability straight-through gate; biased estimator, no unselected Cell gradients

execution: two T4, independent arms; soft+fixed on one GPU, hard+global on the other; alternate placement per seed
quality: same tokenizer/train windows/validation windows and 10M tokens each; FP16 GradScaler; no budget truncation interpreted as success

measurement.flops: Observe actual aten.mm/addmm/bmm shapes for all paired validation windows, 2 FLOPs/MAC; SDPA math backend used for all arms in training/evaluation/benchmark so attention GEMMs are counted; excludes non-matmul/backward, not total hardware FLOPs; uncovered fused attention invalidates gates
measurement.latency: resident identical first validation batch, five warmups + twenty synchronized host measurements; no profiler during timing
measurement.kernel_time: sum CUDA activity durations across paired validation, isolated from timing; instrumentation overhead and kernel overlap affect interpretation

gates.minimum: abs(hard_ppl/soft_ppl-1)<=0.01 AND hard observed GEMM FLOPs < soft
gates.strong: hard_ppl <= global_ppl*1.01 AND hard latency <= fixed latency
gates.exploratory_signal: abs(hard_ppl/fixed_ppl-1)<=0.01 AND hard observed GEMM FLOPs < 0.30*fixed AND hard latency < fixed

decision: minimum controls development status, all other gates reported separately; all three paired seeds must complete and pass individually for matrix support; scientific_decision always false
claims: architecture-specific TinyStories development; never general superiority over MoE/Transformer or proof of CLM
failure_policy: save partial evidence/checkpoints where time allows; incomplete/failed arms and unavailable measurements cannot pass; immutable observed seeds, no overwrite
attention_backend: SDPA math for every arm, not a fused-attention production benchmark

dependencies.torch: Kaggle platform version recorded, all arms identical
